top_signals.title: Chile Finance Minister Floats Idea of Private Capital at Codelco
top_signals.summary: Chile’s right-wing government opened the door to bringing private capital into copper giant Codelco in a way that retains state control, the latest twist in a debate over the indebted company’s future.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Situational Awareness offloads large portion of public equity holdings
top_signals.summary: The $20bn hedge fund run by Leopold Aschenbrenner suffered steep losses in recent days from tech sell-off
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
